ref_en: You represent the Tarot Club, and it is meaningless to oppose you. I just hope you can understand. Long live understanding—did Emperor Roselle say that?

source_cn: 你在大学城捡到了愚者教会福音宣传，有些好奇，于是深夜寻访奇迹邮筒，结果发现有无数学生真的在拜邮筒，并且真的发生了奇迹。到最后才得知，一切的一切都是因为愚者教会的神使需要资料来完成论文……长夜漫漫，旧的论文终于结束了，但新的论文又要开始了，神使大人……真的能写完吗？
ref_en: You pick up a gospel pamphlet for the Church of the Fool in the University District and, out of curiosity, visit the Miracle Mailbox late at night. You discover that countless students are truly praying to the mailbox, and miracles are actually happening. In the end, you learn that everything is because the emissary of the Church of the Fool needs data to finish a thesis... The night is long, the old thesis is finally finished, but a new one is about to begin. Can the emissary... really finish it?

source_cn: 【非凡历史】为常驻结交人脉活动。 概率信息</> <Highlight>[传说]</>品质人脉：基础概率为1.5%，综合概率（含保底）为3.74% 包含：奥黛丽·霍尔、伦纳德·米切尔、佛尔思·沃尔、邓恩·史密斯、戴莉·西蒙妮、阿尔杰·威尔逊 <Highlight>[史诗]</>品质人脉：基础概率为10%，综合概率（含保底）为22.56% 包含：苏茜、洛薇雅·蒂芙尼、老尼尔、弗莱、弗兰克·李、班森·莫雷蒂、梅丽莎·莫雷蒂 <Highlight>[常规道具]相关</>：基础概率为88.5%，综合概率（含保底）为73.70% 包含：基础物质、聚合因子 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>结交细则</> 1、每5次结交，必定获得一位史诗或以上的人脉。 2、如果连续24次结交未获得传说人脉，则后续概率逐渐提升。 每40次结交必定获得传说人脉。 获得传说人脉后计数重置，概率恢复为基础概率。 3、【非凡历史】的保底次数与其它活动独立计算，互不影响。 4、可通过许愿提升结交获得对应人脉的概率。 许愿后，获得传说人脉时，对应目标概率提高到80%。 如果获得的传说人脉不是目标，则下次获得传说人脉必为许愿目标。 许愿每周可生效2次，周一重置。 每当结交人脉110次，可额外获得一次许愿次数。该次数不会被重置，且消耗优先级低于每周重置的次数。 5、本活动每日可获得100次结交次数，最多可累计至700次。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>重复获得人脉</> 重复获得相同传说人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和10个投影片段。如果该传说人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为40个投影片段。 重复获得相同史诗人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和2个投影片段。如果该史诗人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为2个投影片段。 投影片段可用于在人脉商店兑换道具。
ref_en: [Beyonder History] is a permanent Befriending Connections activity. Probability Information </> <Highlight> [Legendary] </> Quality Connection: Base probability is 1.5%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 3.74%. Includes: Audrey Hall, Leonard Mitchell, Fors Wall, Dunn Smith, Daly Simone, Alger Wilson. <Highlight> [Epic] </> Quality Connection: Base probability is 10%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 22.56%. Includes: Susie, Lovia Tiffany, Old Neil, Frye, Frank Lee, Benson Moretti, Melissa Moretti. <Highlight> [General Items] Related </>: Base probability is 88.5%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 73.70%. Includes: Basic Materials, Aggregation Factors. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Befriending Details </> 1. Every 5 Befriending attempts, you are guaranteed to obtain a Connection of Epic quality or higher. 2. If you do not obtain a Legendary Connection in 24 consecutive Befriending attempts, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary Connection every 40 Befriending attempts. After obtaining a Legendary Connection, the count resets, and the probability returns to the base probability. 3. The pity count for [Beyonder History] is calculated independently of other activities and does not affect each other. 4. You can increase the probability of obtaining a corresponding Connection through wishing. After wishing, when you obtain a Legendary Connection, the probability of the corresponding target increases to 80%. If the Legendary Connection obtained is not the target, the next Legendary Connection obtained is guaranteed to be the wish target. Wishing can be effective twice a week, resetting on Monday. Every time you perform 110 Befriending attempts, you can obtain an additional wish count. This count will not be reset, and its consumption priority is lower than the weekly reset count. 5. In this activity, you can obtain 100 Befriending attempts per day, which can be accumulated up to 700 times. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Repeatedly Obtaining Connections </> When you repeatedly obtain the same Legendary Connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding Connection improvement material and 10 Projection Fragments. If that Legendary Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the excess improvement materials will be converted into 40 Projection Fragments. When you repeatedly obtain the same Epic Connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding Connection improvement material and 2 Projection Fragments. If that Epic Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the excess improvement materials will be converted into 2 Projection Fragments. Projection Fragments can be used to exchange for items in the Connection Shop.

source_cn: 他们都回归了黑夜的国度，和我一样。
ref_en: They have all returned to the Kingdom of Evernight, just like me.

source_cn: 依我看，这事儿肯定是幽灵作祟！
ref_en: In my opinion, this must be the work of a ghost!

source_cn: 刚才我和她说的话，都是私下闲聊，请不要当真。
ref_en: What I said to her just now was private chatter, please don't take it seriously.

source_cn: 参与副本<Highlight>五月庄园·花园（普通）</>，击败<Highlight>先祖铠甲</>后，有概率获得下列外观。
ref_en: Participate in the dungeon <Highlight>May Manor · Garden (Normal)</>. After defeating <Highlight>Ancestor Armor</>, there is a chance to obtain the following appearances.

source_cn: 可是，我想当的是婚礼乐师，不是驱鸟师……
ref_en: But, I want to be a wedding musician, not a bird scarer...

source_cn: 呼，呼……得救了。谢、谢谢你啊……
ref_en: Phew, phew... I'm saved. Th-thank you...

source_cn: 咳咳，今天这锅炉怎么这么呛！
ref_en: Cough, cough, why is this boiler so smoky today!

source_cn: 哈哈，我一辈子也就这样了。
ref_en: Haha, this is how my life will be.

source_cn: 噢，到时间去取金奶奶的信了。
ref_en: Oh, it's time to go get Grandma Gold's letter.

source_cn: 奥利安娜太太，您还好吗？
如今，我真的成为“星星”了，才理解了他这句话的含义。
ref_en: Now that I've truly become a 'Star', I understand the meaning of his words.

source_cn: 它们的每片羽毛都闪烁着自由的光辉！
ref_en: Every one of their feathers shines with the brilliance of freedom!
Watch out! You have been targeted by 2-049!

source_cn: 巷尾的邮差，总把信件举高些，怕被路边的狗勾扒拉。
ref_en: The postman at the end of the alley always holds the letters high, afraid they might be snatched by the dogs on the street.

ref_en: Cannot change skills in the current state.
I have to get some out...

ref_en: How could it? No one can see me, and even if they did, they'd think they were seeing things.

source_cn: 恋爱结果不算——我知道这是大家最关心的问题，但我连自己的问题都没解决，更不要提给别人占卜啦。
ref_en: Love results don't count—I know this is what everyone is most concerned about, but I haven't even solved my own problems, let alone perform divination for others.

ref_en: You have reached the limit of %d messages in the %s channel; cannot continue sending.

source_cn: 感谢您的馈赠，果然舒服多了。
ref_en: Thank you for the gift, it really is much more comfortable.

source_cn: 我和我哥哥杰姆为雷克斯先生工作，就是清洗烟囱。
ref_en: My brother Jem and I work for Mr. Rex, cleaning chimneys.

source_cn: 我和木马骑士呆在一起。这里很安静。
ref_en: I'm staying with the Wooden Horse Knight. It's very quiet here.

source_cn: 我的小包包，也是个封印物。
ref_en: My little bag is also a Sealed Artifact.

source_cn: 我记得三年前过来的时候，就在这边！
ref_en: I remember when we came here three years ago, it was right here!

source_cn: 拉姆齐擅长用破碎的笔触营造雾气的流动感。 但是您看……这幅画下笔规整。像是在模仿记忆中的印象，而非捕捉瞬间的朦胧。
ref_en: Ramsey excels at using broken brushstrokes to create a sense of flowing mist. But look... the brushwork here is orderly. It's like imitating an impression from memory rather than capturing a fleeting moment of haze.

source_cn: 接着，梭哈！赢回我的一切。
ref_en: Next, go all in! Win back everything I've lost.

ref_en: Viscous liquid with a strange smell... Unprovokedly spat on by a drunkard on the side of the road with A Mouthful of Phlegm.

ref_en: Sir is too sincere with us; he even told us directly about the factory's predicament...

ref_en: Gain 1 advanced replicator; gain another after 10 cumulative PVP rounds.

ref_en: When Spectator generates healing, it deals damage to enemies in a large area around you; this effect has a 2-second internal Cooldown.

source_cn: 让你意外吗？不是只有水手、海盗才信仰风暴之主。奥古斯都家族从鲁恩立国开始一直信仰“风暴之主”，我的家族亦是因航海而崛起。
ref_en: Does it surprise you? It's not just sailors and pirates who believe in the Lord of Storms. The Augustus family has believed in the "Lord of Storms" since the founding of Loen, and my family also rose because of navigation.

source_cn: 诡秘主线·第四章·开头闪回
ref_en: Lord of the Mysteries Main Story - Chapter 4 - Opening Flashback

source_cn: 还有，角落卡座里的那个男人，也神神秘秘的。
ref_en: Also, that man in the corner booth is acting all mysterious too.

ref_en: These are all my titles, okay? Okay.

ref_en: This passing {{Mr.|Ms.}}, are you also here to visit the church?

ref_en: This is goods you can't buy in Loen; 3 pounds is a bargain for you.

ref_en: What is that sneaky guy looking for? An informant?

ref_en: Then, {{PlayerName}}, did you smell the fragrance of the daisies at that time? \n<P_Yellow> (Note: Different choices will lead the story to different endings.) </>

ref_en: The formula for that perfume is very precious, and people who don't know anything about it will only haggle, making Miss Naila unhappy.

ref_en: The captain is back, he wants you to go to his <P_Yellow>office</>. However, the captain's face is unusually pale, I don't know what happened.

source_cn: “世界”先生，你给予的那件非凡武器超乎我预料得好，我已经攒够功勋，兑换到材料，晋升序列8了。
ref_en: "The World", the Beyonder weapon you provided was better than I expected. I have saved enough merit to exchange for materials and advance to Sequence 8.

source_cn: 不以血缘相连，却以誓言共筑。在这个非凡与疯狂并存的世界里，你选择了最珍贵的事——相信彼此。
ref_en: Not connected by blood, but built together by oaths. In this world where the extraordinary and madness coexist, you have chosen the most precious thing—trusting each other.

source_cn: 不要着急，得先搞清现在的情况……也得整理一下房间，这里看起来像个命案现场。
ref_en: Don't rush. I need to figure out the current situation first... and I should tidy up the room; it looks like a crime scene.

source_cn: 不识抬举的小家伙们！等你们饿得受不了的时候，可别回来求我……
ref_en: Ungrateful little brats! When you're starving and can't take it anymore, don't come back begging me...

source_cn: 不，我并不为此感到伤心。那些记忆很久远，而且，那时的我人性淡漠，对这一切并没有真切的感知。
ref_en: No, I don't feel sad about that. Those memories are very distant, and at that time, my humanity was indifferent, so I didn't have a real perception of all this.

source_cn: 两镑四苏勒。做工扎实，不出风头。
ref_en: Two pounds and four shillings. Solid craftsmanship, nothing too flashy.

source_cn: 他……看起来比实际年龄大一些。不是因为老，是因为……操心的事情太多。
ref_en: He... looks older than his actual age. Not because he's old, but because... he worries about too many things.
Tell me, do you think he'll write back this time?
Take one last look at them

source_cn: 击杀隐藏在意识深处的7个怪物
ref_en: Kill the 7 monsters hidden in the depths of the consciousness

source_cn: 听说他好像很快就反悔了，声称自己没有做过这件事。但凯娜小姐在进行协议公证时就陪在他身边，是天然的证人。
ref_en: I heard he seemed to go back on his word very quickly, claiming he never did such a thing. But Miss Kena was by his side when the agreement was notarized, so she is a natural witness.

source_cn: 哼……小心我连你一起收拾！
ref_en: Hmph... watch out or I'll deal with you too!

source_cn: 困难副本全通并完成全部BOSS单项黄铜书。
ref_en: Complete all hard dungeons and finish all boss individual Brass Books.

source_cn: 在序章现实主线中，觉醒不灭之力，并战胜月之污染
ref_en: In the prologue main story, awaken Undying Power and defeat the Moon Corruption.

source_cn: 太棒了安多！我就知道你一定可以！
ref_en: That's amazing, Andor! I knew you could do it!

source_cn: 套好成组的绳索，探索者们迎霜踏雪，叩问人迹罕至的荒原。
ref_en: With ropes neatly coiled, the explorers face the frost and snow, questioning the desolate wilderness where few have trodden.

source_cn: 她给了我一个能做实验的地方，让我可以继续做研究。
ref_en: She gave me a place to do experiments, allowing me to continue my research.

source_cn: 如果是“月亮”先生的话，他听到你说吸血鬼，可能会很生气，然后告诉你他很生气，应该不会再做什么了。
ref_en: If it's Mr. Moon, he might get very angry when he hears you say vampire, and then tell you he is very angry, but he probably won't do anything else.

source_cn: 姜汁啤酒！我可太想念这个味道了
ref_en: Ginger beer! I've missed this taste so much.

ref_en: Very good. <P_Yellow>Sticking to your initial choice when the probability of a true bullet was higher</> is not wrong, but even <P_Yellow>small-probability failures</> do happen, don't they?

ref_en: Mind Giant Dragon Might sweeps the front, dealing <HighLight>180%</> attack damage and knocking back, reducing enemy attack by <HighLight>12%</> for 4 seconds.

source_cn: 我只是看一眼。用我自己的钱……
ref_en: I'm just taking a look. With my own money...

ref_en:
Warzone screening points are only obtained during the Four-Way League in the <Highlight> Warzone Screening Period </>. Only Clubs in the <Highlight> Mythical Group </> can earn Strategic Server screening points. During the screening period, Clubs participate in the Four-Way League and accumulate points; after the screening ends, rankings will be based on the cumulative points in this warzone, with the <Highlight> top 4 Clubs advancing to the Strategic Server </>. 
 In each match of the Four-Way League, the first and second place teams enter the Winners' Bracket, while the third and fourth place teams enter the Losers' Bracket; after the second match, the 1st to 8th place for this round are determined based on the match results. 
 Warzone screening points are composed of the cumulative <Highlight> Single-Match Placement Points </> and <Highlight> Final Round Ranking Points </>: 
 <Highlight> Single-Match Placement Points: </> 1st place: 30 points, 2nd place: 15 points, 3rd place: 10 points, 4th place: 5 points. 
 <Highlight> First Round Final Ranking Points: </> 1st place: 60 points, 2nd place: 50 points, 3rd place: 45 points, 4th place: 40 points, 5th to 8th place: 10 points each. 
 <Highlight> Second Round Final Ranking Points: </> 1st place: 200 points, 2nd place: 100 points, 3rd place: 70 points, 4th place: 50 points, 5th to 8th place: 15 points each. 
 <Highlight> Tie-breaking Rules: </> Warzone screening rankings are prioritized by <Highlight> Total Warzone Screening Points </> from highest to lowest. When total points are equal: after the first or second round of the league ends, the ranking is based on the Club's <Highlight> Final Ranking </> in that round, with the higher rank taking priority; after the first match of each Four-Way League round, the final ranking for the round has not yet been determined, so tied Clubs are not distinguished by rank, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking for the round. 
 <Highlight> Additional God-Chosen Seats: </> When the Strategic Server settles, the top three Clubs in the warzone during screening can receive additional God-Chosen Seats: <Highlight> 1st place: 10 seats, 2nd place: 5 seats, 3rd place: 5 seats </>.

老尼尔，黑荆棘资历最深的老前辈之一。他会教你冥想、灵视，还会教你在报销单上如何“合理”填数字。他欠账三十镑时，也能对捡来的三百镑钱包分文不动。
“为所欲为，但勿伤害”，是他恪守一生的格言。
他曾是正式值夜者，但离晋升始终差了那么一步。年纪渐长，教会让他转做“看守者”或回家休养，他拒绝了。他只愿留在黑荆棘，守着那些泛黄的典籍，为大家点亮一盏灯。
在平常幽默风趣的相处中，没人知道，老尼尔一直在节省资金，试图用禁忌的“生命炼成”仪式复活亡妻。他在需要鲜血材料的配方旁写道：“可以考虑抽取我的。”——他宁愿用自己的血，也不愿伤害任何人。
直到隐匿贤者的低语吞没他，队友亲手送别他……当值夜者们翻开老尼尔的日记，看见最后一页写着：“如果不能拯救她，那就去陪伴她。”时，他们终于明白了老尼尔最后的坚守。
他想用余生为年轻人照亮一小段路，然后用生命，践行一句无人知晓的誓言。
ref_en:
Old Neil, one of the most senior veterans of Blackthorn. He would teach you meditation and spirit vision, and he would also teach you how to "reasonably" fill in numbers on expense reports. When he owed thirty pounds, he could also leave a three-hundred-pound wallet he found untouched. 
 "Do what you will, but do no harm" was the motto he upheld his whole life. 
 He was once an official Nighthawk, but he was always one step away from promotion. As he grew older, the Church asked him to become a "Gatekeeper" or retire at home, but he refused. He only wished to stay at Blackthorn, guarding those yellowed classics and lighting a lamp for everyone. 
 In their usual humorous interactions, no one knew that Old Neil had been saving money, trying to resurrect his late wife with the forbidden "Life Creation" ritual. Next to the formula that required blood materials, he wrote: "Can consider extracting mine."—He would rather use his own blood than hurt anyone. 
 Until the whispers of the Hidden Sage engulfed him, and his teammates sent him off with their own hands... When the Nighthawks opened Old Neil's diary and saw the last page written: "If I cannot save her, then I will accompany her," they finally understood Old Neil's final persistence. 
 He wanted to illuminate a short path for the young people with the rest of his life, and then use his life to practice a vow that no one knew.

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与伯德温·威瑟尔遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对伯德温·威瑟尔的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302113">伯德温·威瑟尔的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with Baldwin Wetherell. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing Baldwin Wetherell: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302113">Records of Baldwin Wetherell</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

庆功宴将持续一整晚……
　　正当大家准备散场时，有人大喊——戈登失踪了。
　　听声音是戴维。据他所说，他们本来在一起喝酒，戈登突然就不见了。
　　曼斯教授让所有人帮忙找，大家从营地找到营地外，都没有找到。
　　当所有人回到营地后，戴维也不见了。
　　戈登和戴维是最先发现山顶遗迹的人，也是最早失踪的。营地里去过山顶遗迹的人，都担心下一个失踪的是自己。
　　尽管接下来的几天里没有人失踪，但曼斯教授和几位研究员都提议暂时撤离，我们只好收拾东西，准备离开。
ref_en:
The celebration party will last all night...
　　Just as everyone was preparing to disperse, someone shouted—Gordon is missing.
　　It sounded like David. According to him, they were drinking together when Gordon suddenly disappeared.
　　Professor Mans asked everyone to help look for him. Everyone searched from the camp to outside the camp, but couldn't find him.
　　When everyone returned to the camp, David was also gone.
　　Gordon and David were the first to discover the ruins at the summit, and they were also the first to go missing. Everyone in the camp who had been to the summit ruins was worried that they would be the next to disappear.
　　Although no one went missing in the following days, Professor Mans and several researchers proposed a temporary withdrawal, so we had to pack our things and prepare to leave.

<Assistant_Title1>【Club - Club Positions】</>
<Assistant_Title2>President: </>The President is the leader of the club, holding the highest authority and capable of representing the club in handling all internal management and diplomatic rights. 
<Assistant_Title2>Vice President: </>The Vice President is an important position that supports the President, holding high-level authority second only to the President. They can act on behalf of the President to exercise certain internal management and diplomatic rights, and are appointed by the President. 
<Assistant_Title2>Director: </>A Director is a management position within the club, possessing a certain degree of management authority. They are appointed by the President, with a maximum of 3. 
<Assistant_Title2>Group Leader: </>A Group Leader is the core management for club activities, responsible for the appointment and dismissal of members within the group, organizing league teams, and other gameplay activities. Each club has 4 groups, each with a maximum of 30 members. Members within a group automatically gain eligibility to participate in the league. 
<Assistant_Title2>Club Star: </>The Club Star is the face of the club, responsible for recruiting and welcoming new members. They are appointed by the President, with a maximum of 2. 
<Assistant_Title2>Full Member: </>Full Members are the backbone of the club and can participate in guild gameplay activities. <Assistant_Red>Some activities only support participation by Full Members</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Probationary Member: </>Probationary members are the reserve force of the club. They cannot participate in some guild gameplay. They can continue to work hard, stay active, and contact management to join as a member. 
<Assistant_Title2>Position Adjustment: </>Club members can concurrently hold management positions, group positions, and the Club Star position; management positions include President, Vice President, and Director. 
<Assistant_Title2>Permission Adjustment: </>The Club President can adjust the permission distribution for different positions in the permission adjustment interface.

来自白银城的木质手杖，杖头绿得像巨人王庭台阶上终年不减的苔藓。
“左臂被污染了。”那天，长老说，“要么截肢，要么……”
他看向角落里的手杖。
伤者是个年轻的战士，才十六岁。截肢意味着再也无法战斗，在白银城，这比死更可怕。
“用吧。”少年说。
手杖轻触伤口，血肉瞬间愈合。代价在三天后显现——他的左臂长出了变异的藤蔓，但他能继续握剑。
“至少，”他对哭泣的母亲说，“我还是个战士。”
ref_en:
A wooden cane from the City of Silver, its head as green as the moss that grows year-round on the steps of the Giant King's Court. 
 "The left arm is corrupted," the Elder said that day. "Either amputate it, or..." 
 He looked at the cane in the corner. 
 The wounded was a young warrior, only sixteen years old. Amputation meant he could never fight again; in the City of Silver, that was worse than death. 
 "Use it," the boy said. 
 The cane touched the wound, and the flesh healed instantly. The price manifested three days later—mutated vines grew from his left arm, but he could continue to hold his sword. 
 "At least," he said to his weeping mother, "I am still a warrior."

<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>高原战</>是势力战中的<Assistant_Red>800人</>战场。战场资格会在每轮四方联赛第一场结束后<Assistant_Red>21:00</>分配，获得资格的俱乐部成员可在<Assistant_System>以战养战-势力-高原战</>界面查看赛程安排。
<Assistant_Title2>核心目标：</>各势力需要争夺战场中央平台上的<Assistant_Property1>死亡骑士</>。死亡骑士会跟随身边<Assistant_Red>20米</>内非凡者数量最多的势力，且获得跟随至少需要<Assistant_Red>5人</>。死亡骑士身边的势力会定时增加势力积分，获得死亡骑士跟随的势力加分更高。
<Assistant_Title2>胜利规则：</>成功将死亡骑士送达本阵营广场，可额外获得<Assistant_Red>1200势力积分</>。达到<Assistant_Red>15000势力积分</>的势力会提前获胜；战斗结束时，会根据四皇势力积分排名发放不同档次奖励。
<Assistant_Title2>劣势机制：</>与第一名相差<Assistant_Red>3000势力积分</>的势力会被视为劣势势力。每<Assistant_Red>5分钟</>，劣势势力广场前会投放<Assistant_Property1>绊马索</>，只有本势力非凡者可以拾取，使用后可减速死亡骑士；每<Assistant_Red>8分钟</>，劣势势力广场会开启集合传送，需要<Assistant_Red>1名</>非凡者前往广场区域激活，成功后该势力所有非凡者可传送至广场区域并获得强力buff。
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>{JumpToUI:[前往高原战]|1250323}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Highland Battle】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions:</><Assistant_System>Highland Battle</> is an <Assistant_Red>800-player</> battlefield in the Faction War. Battlefield eligibility is assigned at <Assistant_Red>21:00</> after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League. Club members who have obtained eligibility can view the schedule in the <Assistant_System>War-Driven Growth - Faction - Highland Battle</> interface.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective:</>Each faction needs to compete for the <Assistant_Property1>Death Knight</> on the central platform of the battlefield. The Death Knight will follow the faction with the most Beyonders within <Assistant_Red>20 meters</>, and at least <Assistant_Red>5 people</> are required to obtain the follow. Factions near the Death Knight will periodically gain faction points, and the faction followed by the Death Knight gains more points.
<Assistant_Title2>Victory Rules:</>Successfully delivering the Death Knight to your faction's plaza grants an additional <Assistant_Red>1200 faction points</>. The faction that reaches <Assistant_Red>15000 faction points</> wins early; when the battle ends, rewards of different tiers are distributed based on the faction point ranking.
<Assistant_Title2>Disadvantage Mechanism:</>Factions with a difference of <Assistant_Red>3000 faction points</> from the first place are considered disadvantaged. Every <Assistant_Red>5 minutes</>, <Assistant_Property1>Tripwires</> will be dropped in front of the disadvantaged faction's plaza, which can only be picked up by Beyonders of that faction. Using them can slow down the Death Knight. Every <Assistant_Red>8 minutes</>, a group teleport will open at the disadvantaged faction's plaza, requiring <Assistant_Red>1</> Beyonder to go to the plaza area to activate it. Once successful, all Beyonders of that faction can teleport to the plaza area and gain a powerful buff.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate:</>{JumpToUI:[Go to Highland Battle]|1250323}

ref_en: Received your letter; I have returned to Backlund from Intis. The days of separation were already burning a flame of pain in my heart, and your words have only added to my despair.\nPlease do not doubt the depth of our affection. If you must doubt it, please look into my eyes and say these cruel words again.\nI have booked a table at our familiar restaurant for a week. 致迷途的羔羊与渴求庇护的灵魂：

我主自称愚者，在过去，在现在，也在未来，他是支配灵界的伟大主宰，也是执掌好运的黄黑之王，更是每个生灵追求永恒的道标。

他是怜悯的，他是仁慈的，他是这个世界的救主……他的仁爱播撒在人间，为家家户户带去温暖。我们将这关怀化作触手可及的回馈，将愚者的福音传遍大地……

如有聆听福音的需要，请根据背面的地图指引，于夜深人静之时拜访<Letter_Highlight>奇迹邮筒</>。

<Letter_Normal_HW>注：请不要在公开场合宣传愚者教会。</>
ref_en:
To the lost lambs and souls seeking shelter:

My Lord calls himself the Fool. In the past, in the present, and in the future, he is the great master who dominates the Spirit World, the King of Yellow and Black who holds good luck, and the beacon for every living being pursuing eternity.

He is compassionate, he is merciful, he is the savior of this world... His benevolence is spread among the people, bringing warmth to every household. We turn this care into tangible feedback, spreading the gospel of the Fool across the land...

If you have a need to listen to the gospel, please visit the <Letter_Highlight>Miracle Mailbox</> in the dead of night according to the map on the back.

<Letter_Normal_HW>Note: Please do not promote the Church of the Fool in public.</>

<Assistant_Title1>【隐秘空间】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>“魔术师”女士佛尔思利用空间隐匿将部分失控区域隐藏，留下特殊图腾。非凡者可开启，但请小心，有概率将你传送至未知区域。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找隐秘空间</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【隐秘空间】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【隐秘空间】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 进入隐秘空间</>
到达入口后，与投影互动，即可进入对应的隐秘空间。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 完成挑战</>
完成隐秘空间内的挑战后，获得宝箱奖励，并提升对应探索进度。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Hidden Space】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>The Magician, Fors, uses space concealment to hide certain areas that have suffered from loss of control, leaving behind special totems. Beyonders can open them, but be careful—there is a chance you will be teleported to an unknown area.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding a Hidden Space</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Hidden Space] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Hidden Space] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Entering the Hidden Space</>
After arriving at the entrance, interact with the projection to enter the corresponding Hidden Space.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Completing the Challenge</>
After completing the challenge within the Hidden Space, you will receive a treasure chest reward and increase your exploration progress for that area.

source_cn:
在吃的法则里，风味重于一切。 多年前，我第一次在南方吃到库克的菜时，就体会到了这句美食的真谛。
　　库克是第一个将自然的馈赠以最美妙的方式采集，捡拾，挖掘，捕捞，并最终烹饪上桌的人。
　　还在南方时，库克就会将猪油熬制后封存数日，加入蔬菜……在一道简单的猪油炸蔬菜上桌之前，库克往往会花费五个月，甚至更长的时间去准备原食材。
　　现在，库克将南方海岸线的美味带到了鲁恩，带到了廷根，我认为这是“厨王之王”送给廷根最好的礼物。
　　　　——刊于老实人报美食版面
ref_en:
In the laws of eating, flavor is above all else. Many years ago, when I first tasted Cook's cooking in the South, I realized the true meaning of this gourmet philosophy. 
 Cook was the first person to collect, pick, dig, fish, and finally cook the gifts of nature in the most wonderful way. 
 While still in the South, Cook would render lard and seal it for several days, adding vegetables... Before a simple dish of lard-fried vegetables was served, Cook would often spend five months or even longer preparing the raw ingredients. 
 Now, Cook has brought the delicacies of the southern coastline to Loen, to Tingen. I believe this is the best gift the "King of Chefs" has given to Tingen. 
 ——Published in the Gourmet section of the Honest Man Newspaper

亲爱的非凡者：
      这些时日以来，您已在廷根留下了不少足迹。您的每一次战斗、每一次选择、每一次对这个世界产生的好奇心，都为我们照亮了前路。

      您所传递的一切声音，都将成为指引我们前行的明灯。
      感谢您为这世界带来的改变。祝愿您早日消化魔药，掌控非凡。
ref_en:
<M_Red>「Complete the questionnaire and receive 400 Bound Pounds!」</>
<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="web=%s">Public Beta Survey 3</>
Dear Beyonder:
      Over these days, you have left quite a few footprints in Tingen. Every battle, every choice, and every curiosity you have had about this world has illuminated the path forward for us. 
      At this very moment, as your experience and acting deepen, do you have a clearer understanding of this world? What content has left a deep impression on you, and what areas make you feel confused or imperfect? This is not just a questionnaire, but an important vote you are casting for the continuous improvement of this world. 
      Every voice you convey will become a beacon guiding us forward. 
      Thank you for the changes you have brought to this world. May you digest your potion and master your Extraordinary powers soon.

灵摆转动方向与速度对应不同指引强度：
 ▸顺时针快速摆动为强烈肯定 / 顺遂倾向
 ▸顺时针慢速摆动为微弱肯定 / 平缓趋势
 ▸逆时针快速摆动为强烈否定 / 阻滞风险
 ▸逆时针慢速摆动为微弱否定 / 潜在阻碍
 ▸静止则代表无明确启示或存在干扰
ref_en:
Relying on the secret connection between the astral body, the Spirit World, and the starry sky, use a pendulum made of crystal, gemstone, or special metal as a medium to perceive the fortune and trends of a target. 
 The direction and speed of the pendulum's rotation correspond to different levels of guidance: 
 ▸ Rapid clockwise swing: Strong affirmation / Favorable trend 
 ▸ Slow clockwise swing: Weak affirmation / Gentle trend 
 ▸ Rapid counter-clockwise swing: Strong negation / Stagnation risk 
 ▸ Slow counter-clockwise swing: Weak negation / Potential obstacle 
 ▸ Stationary: No clear revelation or interference present

<InvDefault>1. As part of the ‘Path of the Beyonder, Thank You for the Journey’ benefit program, more ways to obtain 【Zero-Cost Vouchers】 have been added this week, with the following changes:</>

<InvDefault>1）New rewards: the original Treasure Chest's </><InvHighlight>rare-drop rate for Divine Descent Surprise Gift Boxes is unchanged, while Zero-Cost Vouchers and several pound-voucher reward types have been added</><InvDefault>. <InvDefault>2）Opening method changed: </><InvHighlight>Divine Descent Surprise Gift Boxes now require manual confirmation instead of opening automatically by default</><InvDefault>.</>

<InvDefault>2.【Story】</>
<InvDefault>1）Fixed the main quest not starting normally upon reaching the required level under special circumstances.</>
<InvDefault>2）Fixed excessively long black screens during some steps of the real-world main quest 《Guardian of Tingen》.</>

<InvDefault>4）Improved the Skip pacing of some main-story cinematics.</>

<InvDefault>1）Reduced skill damage after failing the Locke King scam-trap and Debt Protection mechanics in 【Blackthorn Casebook · Sin of Gold】.</>

source_cn:
攻击方的攻击会根据双方的破甲-护甲对抗进行数值修正。
自身破甲低于目标护甲的¼时，每1点破甲提升自身2点攻击。
自身破甲超过目标护甲¼但小于目标护甲时，每3点破甲提升自身2点攻击。
自身破甲超过目标护甲时，每3点破甲提升自身1点攻击。
ref_en:
The attacker's attack will be numerically adjusted based on the Armor Break vs. Armor confrontation between both parties. 
 When your own Armor Break is less than ¼ of the target's Armor, every 1 point of Armor Break increases your own attack by 2 points. 
 When your own Armor Break exceeds ¼ of the target's Armor but is less than the target's Armor, every 3 points of Armor Break increases your own attack by 2 points. 
 When your own Armor Break exceeds the target's Armor, every 3 points of Armor Break increases your own attack by 1 point.

<Assistant_Title1>【四方联赛】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>四方联赛</>是俱乐部之间的大型战场玩法。每场由<Assistant_Red>4家俱乐部</>同场竞技，每家俱乐部最多出战<Assistant_Red>60名正式成员</>，单局共<Assistant_Red>240名玩家</>参战；同一俱乐部单个途径最多上场<Assistant_Red>16人</>。每场比赛持续<Assistant_Red>23分钟</>。
<Assistant_Title2>赛制规则：</>每轮比赛由两场对阵组成。每轮第一场开始前，本组第1、2名，第3、4名，第5、6名以及第7、8名分别进入不同的比赛小组，并在满足该规则的前提下随机分配。第一场各组前2名进入胜者组，后2名进入败者组；第二场分别进行胜者组与败者组对决，确定本轮第1至第8名。
<Assistant_Title2>胜负规则：</>率先获得<Assistant_Red>3000积分</>的俱乐部立即锁定胜局；若对局结束时无人达到3000分，则按当前积分排名。积分相同时，依次比较<Assistant_Property1>总击杀数</>、<Assistant_Property1>俱乐部非凡评分总和</>。
<Assistant_Title2>局内积分：</>局内积分唯一来源为守卫归属结算。首次占领守卫获得<Assistant_Red>50积分</>；每<Assistant_Red>5秒</>小结算时，每个已占领守卫提供<Assistant_Red>1积分</>；每<Assistant_Red>30秒</>大结算时，每个已占领守卫提供<Assistant_Red>18积分</>。对局第<Assistant_Red>4、8、12、16、20分钟</>会随机刷新守卫归属高倍积分结算，高倍结算时每个已占领守卫提供<Assistant_Red>72或108积分</>。
<Assistant_Title2>战略服筛选积分：</>在<Assistant_Property1>战略服筛选阶段</>的联赛前两轮，将启用战略服筛选积分规则。单场第1至第4名依次获得<Assistant_Red>30、15、10、5分</>；第一轮最终第1至第4名依次获得<Assistant_Red>60、50、45、40分</>，第5至第8名各获得<Assistant_Red>10分</>；第二轮最终第1至第4名依次获得<Assistant_Red>200、100、70、50分</>，第5至第8名各获得<Assistant_Red>15分</>。战略服筛选阶段的联赛前两轮结束后，本赛区战略服筛选总积分前4名的俱乐部将晋级<Assistant_Property1>四方联赛天启组</>，并获得<Assistant_Property1>参与战略服</>的资格。
<Assistant_Title2>同分排序：</>战略服筛选排名优先按<Assistant_Property1>战略服筛选总积分</>由高到低排列。总积分相同时：第一轮或第二轮联赛结束后，按照俱乐部在本轮的<Assistant_Property1>最终排名</>排序，排名靠前者优先；四方联赛每轮第一场比赛结束后，本轮尚未产生最终排名，同分俱乐部暂不区分排名先后，当前展示顺序不代表本轮最终排名。
<Assistant_Title2>守卫争夺：</>战场中共有<Assistant_Red>5位守卫</>。完成对守卫最后一击的俱乐部会获得该守卫的控制权；守卫归属后会立即重生并归属本方。守卫无法被治疗，但周围没有敌人时会缓慢自动回血。
<Assistant_Title2>资源与指挥：</>击败敌方玩家或占领守卫可获得资源点，并自动积累士气等级。会长、副会长、理事可消耗资源点释放指挥技能。
<Assistant_Title2>指挥技能：</><Assistant_Property1>克敌宣言</>消耗1000资源点，使全体成员全途径压制提高15%，持续20秒，冷却180秒；<Assistant_Property1>急行进军</>消耗600资源点，使全体成员移动速度提高60%，持续10秒，冷却120秒；<Assistant_Property1>归零敕令</>消耗1500资源点，清除全体成员当前复活等待并覆盖随后5秒内阵亡成员，冷却240秒；<Assistant_Property1>召集传送</>消耗2400资源点，将全体成员召集至指定集结点，冷却240秒；<Assistant_Property1>圣域庇佑</>消耗1000资源点，使本方全部守卫恢复50%最大生命值，冷却180秒。
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>{JumpToUI:[前往四方联赛]|1250063}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Four-Way League】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description:</><Assistant_System>Four-Way League</> is a large-scale battlefield mode between Clubs. Each match features <Assistant_Red>4 Clubs</> competing on the same field, with each Club fielding up to <Assistant_Red>60 official members</>, for a total of <Assistant_Red>240 players</> per match. A single Club may have no more than <Assistant_Red>16 players</> of the same Pathway on the field. Each match lasts <Assistant_Red>23 minutes</>.
<Assistant_Title2>Tournament Rules:</>Each round consists of two matches. Before the first match of each round, the 1st/2nd, 3rd/4th, 5th/6th, and 7th/8th place teams from the current group are assigned to different match groups and randomly distributed while satisfying this rule. The top 2 teams from each group in the first match enter the Winners' Bracket, while the bottom 2 enter the Losers' Bracket. The second match features separate duels for the Winners' and Losers' Brackets to determine the 1st through 8th place for the round.
<Assistant_Title2>Victory Conditions:</>The first Club to reach <Assistant_Red>3000 points</> immediately secures victory. If no one reaches 3000 points when the match ends, rankings are determined by current points. If points are tied, the <Assistant_Property1>total number of kills</> and then the <Assistant_Property1>total Club Beyonder rating</> are compared in order.
<Assistant_Title2>In-Match Points:</>The only source of in-match points is the settlement of Guardian ownership. Occupying a Guardian for the first time grants <Assistant_Red>50 points</>. During the <Assistant_Red>5-second</> minor settlement, each occupied Guardian provides <Assistant_Red>1 point</>. During the <Assistant_Red>30-second</> major settlement, each occupied Guardian provides <Assistant_Red>18 points</>. At the <Assistant_Red>4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 20th minutes</> of the match, Guardian ownership high-multiplier point settlements will randomly refresh, providing <Assistant_Red>72 or 108 points</> per occupied Guardian during high-multiplier settlements.
<Assistant_Title2>Strategic Server Selection Points:</>During the first two rounds of the league in the <Assistant_Property1>Strategic Server Selection phase</>, the Strategic Server Selection point rules will be in effect. 1st through 4th place in a single match receive <Assistant_Red>30, 15, 10, and 5 points respectively</>. For the final 1st through 4th place in the first round, they receive <Assistant_Red>60, 50, 45, and 40 points respectively</>, while 5th through 8th place each receive <Assistant_Red>10 points</>. For the final 1st through 4th place in the second round, they receive <Assistant_Red>200, 100, 70, and 50 points respectively</>, while 5th through 8th place each receive <Assistant_Red>15 points</>. After the first two rounds of the league in the Strategic Server Selection phase conclude, the top 4 Clubs in the region's total Strategic Server Selection points will advance to the <Assistant_Property1>Four-Way League Apocalypse Group</> and earn the qualification to <Assistant_Property1>participate in the Strategic Server</>.
<Assistant_Title2>Tie-Breaking:</>Strategic Server Selection rankings are prioritized by <Assistant_Property1>total Strategic Server Selection points</> from highest to lowest. If total points are tied: After the first or second round of the league concludes, rankings are determined by the Club's <Assistant_Property1>final ranking</> in that round, with higher rankings taking precedence. After the first match of each Four-Way League round, since the final ranking for the round has not yet been determined, tied Clubs will not be distinguished by rank, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking for the round.
<Assistant_Title2>Guardian Contention:</>There are a total of <Assistant_Red>5 Guardians</> on the battlefield. The Club that lands the final blow on a Guardian gains control of it. Once ownership is established, the Guardian will immediately respawn and belong to that side. Guardians cannot be healed, but they will slowly recover Health automatically when no enemies are nearby.
<Assistant_Title2>Resources and Command:</>Defeating enemy players or occupying Guardians grants resource points and automatically accumulates Morale levels. The President, Vice Presidents, and Councilors can consume resource points to cast Command Skills.
<Assistant_Title2>Command Skills:</><Assistant_Property1>Declaration of Defeating the Enemy</> consumes 1000 resource points, increasing all members' Pathway Suppression by 15% for 20 seconds, with a 180-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Forced March</> consumes 600 resource points, increasing all members' movement speed by 60% for 10 seconds, with a 120-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Zero-Reset Edict</> consumes 1500 resource points, clearing the current resurrection wait time for all members and covering members who fall in battle within the following 5 seconds, with a 240-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Summon Teleport</> consumes 2400 resource points, summoning all members to a designated rally point, with a 240-second cooldown; <Assistant_Property1>Sanctuary Blessing</> consumes 1000 resource points, restoring 50% of the maximum Health of all friendly Guardians, with a 180-second cooldown.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate:</>{JumpToUI:[Go to Four-Way League]|1250063}

source_cn:
剑身断了三分之一，断口整齐，像是已经用到了尽头。
剑柄的皮革已经磨透，露出里面的铁， 铁上有密密麻麻的划痕——或许说，是握剑的手留下的痕迹更准确。
铠甲的主人说，剑是用来守护的，不是用来杀戮的。 但守护有时候和杀戮长得一模一样， 区别只在于，你心里护着的是什么。
这把剑守护了六百年，但最后一次出鞘，指错了方向。 可它自己不知道， 所以它还是那把剑。
ref_en:
The blade is broken by a third, the break is neat, as if it had been used to the very end. 
The leather on the hilt has worn through, revealing the iron inside, and the iron is covered with dense scratches—perhaps it is more accurate to say they are traces left by the hand that held the sword. 
The owner of the armor said that the sword is for guarding, not for killing. But guarding sometimes looks exactly like killing, and the only difference is what you are protecting in your heart. 
This sword guarded for six hundred years, but the last time it was drawn, it pointed in the wrong direction. But it didn't know that itself, so it was still that same sword.

戈登和戴维发现了山上一个被积雪覆盖的遗迹入口，他们回到营地将消息报告给曼斯教授，教授当即就带着一些学者和几个护卫往山上赶。
而我和另外几个学员则留在了营地，准备必要的物资。边搬东西的时候我边想，不久后我也要称呼戈登和戴维他们“研究员先生”了吧。
对于新遗迹的考古研究是相当累人的工作，研究员们还在遗迹入口确认遗迹的建筑风格，而我们这些不受重视的学员就只能干剩下的粗重杂活，像是搬运物资或是清理现场之类的。
回到营地，曼斯教授很兴奋，有几个研究员提议在营地开个庆功宴，曼斯教授也同意了，终于能放松一下了。
庆功宴将持续一整晚……
ref_en:
Gordon and David discovered a ruins entrance covered in snow on the mountain. They returned to the camp to report the news to Professor Mans, who immediately rushed to the mountain with some scholars and a few guards. 
 As for me and the other students, we stayed at the camp to prepare the necessary supplies. While moving things, I thought to myself that soon I would also be calling Gordon and David 'Mr. Researcher'. 
 Archaeological research on new ruins is quite exhausting work. The researchers were still confirming the architectural style at the ruins entrance, while we, the undervalued students, could only do the remaining heavy labor, like moving supplies or cleaning up the site. 
 Returning to the camp, Professor Mans was very excited. Several researchers suggested holding a celebration banquet at the camp, and Professor Mans agreed. Finally, we could relax a bit. 
 The celebration banquet will last all night...

source_cn: 一个路过的服务员。你们到底还点不点餐？
ref_en: A waiter passing by. Are you going to order or not?

source_cn: 下午好，{{PlayerName}}，我预感到了你会出现。
ref_en: Good afternoon, {{PlayerName}}, I had a premonition that you would appear.

source_cn: 不 这只是一位被伟大主人眷顾的……新人
ref_en: No, this is just a... newcomer favored by the great master.

source_cn: 与Npc进行对话  玩家移除任务道具（全部删除）
ref_en: Talk to NPC: Player removes quest item (delete all).

source_cn: 两张票可真是用了不少钱…也不知还要再多送多少封信，才能攒出下一份4苏勒零8便士…
ref_en: Two tickets really cost a lot... I don't know how many more letters I'll have to deliver to save up the next 4 shillings and 8 pence...

source_cn: 人脉话题-弗兰克1关于大地母神教会
ref_en: Connection Topic - Frank 1: About the Church of Earth Mother

source_cn: 从法术场id列表里面随机一个在地面创建法术场
ref_en: Randomly create a Spell Field on the ground from a list of Spell Field IDs.

source_cn: 他的一生，只为守护那个最重要的约定。愿你好梦，老尼尔。
ref_en: His life was only to guard that most important promise. May you have a good dream, Old Neil.

source_cn: 优秀的马车夫总能敏锐地找到潜在客户。
ref_en: An excellent carriage driver can always keenly spot potential customers.

source_cn: 候补会员是俱乐部的储备力量，有部分公会玩法无法参与，可继续努力，保持活跃联系管理加入会员。
ref_en: Reserve members are the Club's reserve force; some guild activities are unavailable to them. Keep working hard and stay active to contact management for promotion to official member.

source_cn: 冰冷的月光洒在无人的江边，四周只剩下死一般的寂静。真是个绝佳的葬身之地，对吧？
ref_en: Cold moonlight spilled over the deserted riverside, leaving only deathly silence all around. A perfect place to be buried, don't you think?

source_cn: 刚刚是我鲁莽了，今天吃得很开心，帮我谢谢库克！
ref_en: I was reckless just now. I enjoyed the meal today; please thank Cook for me!

source_cn: 前往指定Trigger位置  玩家发送任务道具  玩家根据InstanceID列表创建公有对象（大世界不生效）  玩家调用展示时间流逝动画
ref_en: Go to specified Trigger location: Player sends quest item, Player creates public object based on InstanceID list (does not take effect in open world), Player calls time-passing animation.

source_cn: 后置氛围：廷根报纸刊登一则新闻【近日，警方在廷根市郊的一处公寓内，发现一名不明原因身亡的年轻女子。经查，死者名为黛丝，早在半年前便已作为已故市民记录于廷根市档案。鉴于存在“死者曾死而复生”的复杂情节，案件真相目前仍在深入调查中。 】
ref_en: Post-atmosphere: The Tingen newspaper published a news item: [Recently, police discovered a young woman who died of unknown causes in an apartment on the outskirts of Tingen. Upon investigation, the deceased was named Daisy, who had been recorded as a deceased citizen in Tingen's archives half a year ago. Given the complex circumstances of the 'deceased having returned from the dead', the truth of the case is still under deep investigation.]

source_cn: 听说是有居民举报，在某处发现了神秘仪式的痕迹。
ref_en: I heard a resident reported finding traces of a mysterious ritual somewhere.

source_cn: 女神啊，请让安宁降临，\n　　让梦境包裹疲惫的灵魂，\n　　让黑夜庇护迷途的羔羊。
ref_en: Oh, Goddess, please let peace descend,\n\tLet dreams wrap around weary souls,\n\tLet the night provide Shelter for the lost lambs.

source_cn: 好了？！她在哪儿，我要去看她！
ref_en: Better?! Where is she, I want to see her!

source_cn: 它们更多地运用了时兴复杂的工艺，造型也更加尖锐别致，齿轮、几何、星芒会让您显得高贵又潮流，价格也很友好。
ref_en: They make more use of trendy and complex craftsmanship, and the shapes are sharper and more unique. Gears, geometry, and starbursts will make you look noble and trendy, and the price is also very friendly.
Cut the crap! Lift your head up!

source_cn: 就算我站在他们面前，他们也绝对想不到，我就是他们要找的人。
ref_en: Even if I stood right in front of them, they would never guess that I am the person they are looking for.

source_cn: 当前认知经验获取效率：<Yellow>%d%%</>
很有意思的诗句啊，柔软的心灵也会被火光所振奋吧……咖啡也不再苦涩了。
ref_en: A very interesting poem. A soft heart would be stirred by the firelight, wouldn't it? The coffee is no longer bitter either.

source_cn: 您位于迷雾残影区域内且已有队伍积分贡献，该状态仅队长可切换分线，如需切换请先退队后继续
ref_en: You are in the Mist Shadow area and already have party point contributions. Only the party leader can switch channels in this state. If you need to switch, please leave the party first and then continue.

source_cn: 我们是水仙花街上最好的餐厅。
ref_en: We are the best restaurant on Daffodil Street.

source_cn: 我在神弃之地游荡千年，寄生过很多像你们这样的人。
ref_en: I have wandered the Forsaken Land of the Gods for a thousand years, parasitizing many people like you.

source_cn: 我想邀请梅丽莎回来参加我的生日宴会，但我不知道她是否有空。
ref_en: I want to invite Melissa back for my birthday party, but I don't know if she's free.

source_cn: 我早就说过嘛！教会迟早会拒绝支票捐款的。
ref_en: I told you! The church would refuse check donations sooner or later.

source_cn: 我猜测，之前是因为夜莺银哨在无意识地保护阿诺德。
ref_en: I suspect it's because the Silver Nightingale Whistle was unconsciously protecting Arnold previously.

source_cn: 我的女神！阿比倒下了！阿比倒下了！出现了新的冠军！让我们欢呼！
ref_en: My Goddess! Abby has fallen! Abby has fallen! A new champion has appeared! Let's cheer!

source_cn: 所以那晚的吻，只是为了摆脱他们？
ref_en: So that kiss that night was just to get rid of them?

source_cn: 拳王又怎么样，胆敢对贝儿小姐不敬，我们得给你点颜色瞧瞧！
ref_en: So what if you're the boxing champion? If you dare to disrespect Miss Belle, we'll show you what's what!

source_cn: 无辜的祭品会被强尼定期召唤出现在场景内，当祭品被强尼击杀后，会释放全范围的冲击波。
ref_en: Innocent sacrifices will be periodically summoned by Johnny to appear in the scene. When a sacrifice is killed by Johnny, it will release a field-wide shockwave.

source_cn: 春夜沙龙……一个贵族死在那里，死因还这么"特别"。
ref_en: Spring Night Salon... A noble died there, and the cause of death was so 'special'.

source_cn: 春夜沙龙的主人，你可以叫我维拉夫人。
ref_en: I am the owner of the Spring Night Salon; you may call me Madam Vera.

source_cn: 此为学员约翰（化名）偷渡到灵界的脚踏车。\n该学员与另一学员皮埃尔（化名）的信使举行竞速比赛，皮埃尔（化名）的信使从魔药房一楼飞上了二楼，约翰骑着脚踏车撞到了生命之脉上，脚踏车损坏，约翰（化名）受伤，在床上修养了半年。\n特此警示，以此为戒。
ref_en: This is the bicycle that student John (pseudonym) used to smuggle himself into the Spirit World.\nThis student held a racing competition with the messenger of another student, Pierre (pseudonym). Pierre's (pseudonym) messenger flew from the first floor of the potion room to the second, while John rode his bicycle and crashed into the Pulse of Life. The bicycle was damaged, and John (pseudonym) was injured, spending half a year recovering in bed.\nThis serves as a warning; let this be a lesson.

source_cn: 求求你，自己跳下去，我就解脱了。

Matches... just one would be enough...

ref_en: Crime Scene - Car Chase Gameplay - Range Marker

ref_en: Cosette! Stop reading, your mom is going to be worried!

source_cn: 罗伯特那家伙，又丢下小罗伯特到哪去了？
ref_en: Where did that guy Robert run off to, leaving little Robert behind again?

source_cn: 老尼尔的历史投影，重现了原主的形态与部分能力。
ref_en: A historical projection of Old Neil, recreating the original's form and partial abilities.

ref_en: Ms. Susie, I heard you are studying psychology?

ref_en: Do you still remember me? Leonard Mitchell, Sequence 8 Midnight Poet.

source_cn: 这里就是花海，情侣约会圣地……
ref_en: This is the Sea of Flowers, a holy site for couples' dates...

source_cn: 那个骗子什么时候出来？
ref_en: When is that liar coming out?

ref_en: Done by a beast? Anyway, take this hunting rifle. Too many strange things have happened lately.

source_cn: 隶属于“黑夜教会”，廷根市值夜者小队队长、黑荆棘安保公司成员。30岁左右。调查韦尔奇和娜娅自杀案时认识克莱恩并邀请他加入值夜者小队，是克莱恩成为非凡者的引路人。最终以生命为代价启用圣遗物阻止邪神降临，保护了廷根。
ref_en: Affiliated with the 'Church of Evernight', captain of the Tingen Nighthawks squad and a member of the Blackthorn Security Company. Around 30 years old. He met Klein while investigating the suicide case of Welch and Naya and invited him to join the Nighthawks squad. He is the guide who led Klein to become a Beyonder. Ultimately, he sacrificed his life to activate a sealed artifact to prevent the descent of an evil god, protecting Tingen.

source_cn: 难怪要不同的内脏器官……抱歉，让你回忆起不好的事情了。
ref_en: No wonder he needed different internal organs... Sorry, I made you recall bad things.

source_cn: 魔术师，从不做无准备的表演。
ref_en: A Magician never performs without preparation.

source_cn:
……

　　那是1173年的特里尔，蒸汽机的白雾继笼罩因蒂斯后，席卷整个黑铁纪元。

　　上万座轰鸣咆哮的工厂平地而起，数亿颗轧轧的齿轮摩擦咬合释出热量。油腻的沾灰的面孔，像迎风翕张的街头小报，源源不断流出厂房，吃力地飞进狭窄的公寓或棚屋，在瓦斯计费器的“叮当”脆响中，藉由煤气管道，于城市的暗夜里连成一片朦胧的光海。
ref_en:
... 
 
 That was Trier in 1173, and the white mist of the steam engine, after shrouding Intis, swept across the entire Iron Age. 
 
 Tens of thousands of roaring factories rose from the ground, and hundreds of millions of clanking gears rubbed and meshed, releasing heat. Greasy, dust-stained faces, like street tabloids flapping in the wind, flowed out of the factories continuously, struggling to fly into narrow apartments or shacks. Amidst the "clinking" of gas meters, through gas pipes, they connected into a hazy sea of light in the dark night of the city.

source_cn:
嘻哈哈
哈哈哈哈哈...
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈...
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈...！
后来，不论是晋升通识者途径序列2的知识导师时，还是跨途径晋升窥秘人途径序列1知识皇帝时，甚至强行转到不相邻途径，晋升序列0黑皇帝时，我都曾回想过当初的选择——选择非凡途径，就是选择敌人和盟友。
ref_en: Later, whether it was when I advanced to Sequence 2 Knowledge Mentor of the Savant pathway, or crossed pathways to advance to Sequence 1 Knowledge Emperor of the Mystery Pryer pathway, or even forcibly switched to a non-adjacent pathway to advance to Sequence 0 Black Emperor, I have always recalled my initial choice—choosing a Beyonder pathway is choosing your enemies and allies.

Standing still in combat for <Mark>5</> seconds decreases Monster Specialization by <Mark>25</> for <Mark>5</> seconds; after a Dodge, Monster Specialization is increased by <Mark>25</> for <Mark>15</> seconds. \nDoes not take effect when the <Mark>Covenant of Iron and Blood</> set is active.

Each hit has a 50% base chance to <HighLight> Stagnate </> and <HighLight> Slow </> the enemy by 50% for 1 second. \n <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="86030010" color="#f4a067"> Reveal Card </> damage reduces the cooldown of <HighLight> Air Bullet </> by 0.5 seconds per hit.

source_cn: ……搞错了？什么意思……罗珊有危险？！
ref_en: ……A mistake? What do you mean…… Is Rozanne in danger?!

source_cn: 【实证】明灯的护盾量增加10%，爆炸伤害增加30%。
ref_en: [Proof] Beacon's Shield amount increased by 10%, Explosion damage increased by 30%.

ref_en: [True Form] The Ritual Magic generated after Nightmare hits will expand twice, and the damage dealt will increase accordingly.

source_cn: 七年了，我还是忘不了被霍尔行长指出记账错误的事情。
ref_en: It's been seven years, and I still can't forget the time Bank Manager Hall pointed out my accounting error.

source_cn: 三色舞池需玩家交互变身为小狒狒才能看见。
ref_en: Players must interact with the Three-Color Dance Floor and transform into a small baboon to see it.

source_cn: 不不不。相处下来，我发现他们为人友善，力气也大，很快，大家就一起捕鱼出海了。不然，你哪能见到我来廷根度假？
ref_en: No, no. After getting along, I found they were friendly and strong, and soon everyone was fishing and going to sea together. Otherwise, how could you see me coming to Tingen for a vacation?

source_cn: 不是陪伴的问题……我把剪羊毛换来的私房钱全藏在咸鱼里了！
ref_en: It's not a question of company... I hid all my private money from shearing sheep in the salted fish!

source_cn: 不能充分享受博弈中随机性的人，不能真正地享受“斗邪恶”。
ref_en: Those who cannot fully enjoy the randomness in a game cannot truly enjoy 'fighting evil'.

source_cn: 不觉得伤害战士很脆么？
ref_en: Don't you think the damage Warrior is very squishy?

source_cn: 为什么不按照约定付工钱？你明知道这点钱什么都做不了。
ref_en: Why didn't you pay the wages as agreed? You know full well that this amount of money can't do anything.

source_cn: 于莫尔斯小镇的金色麦浪中，拾取一段曾经的温柔时光。
ref_en: In the golden wheat waves of Morse Small Town, pick up a segment of gentle time from the past.

source_cn: 交易所等级越高，每周工资加成越高
ref_en: The higher the Exchange level, the higher the weekly salary bonus

source_cn: 亲爱的非凡者：\n你的誓约对象:%s已与其他人缔结了新的誓约。\n爱与羁绊从不设限，愿你们各自的故事都更加丰盈。

source_cn: 人脉话题-洛薇雅3简单的梦

ref_en: What? What are you talking about?

ref_en: They make me work eighteen hours a day! They whip me! They don't give me food!
Peak of the Gods Champion title

source_cn: 但一定需要懂得品味甜点的人！
ref_en: But it definitely needs people who know how to appreciate desserts!

source_cn: 作为最高保密等级，“0”级封印物的搜索传达一直都只有模糊的信息。这点，你应该很清楚。
ref_en: As the highest security level, the search for a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact has always only conveyed vague information. You should be very clear about this.

ref_en: You open the door and invite Ladis in.

ref_en: You have been using divination to solve problems recently, but that doesn't mean you can rely on it. Divination is not omnipotent.

ref_en: Keep the last 6 months of Summon records, with a limit of 1000 records. Record updates may be delayed; if there is no data, please check back later.

source_cn: 写入脚步，写入命运，写入群星编织的秘语。
ref_en: Write into the footsteps, write into fate, write into the secret language woven by the stars.

ref_en: Ice cubes lock in the fresh sweetness of the clam meat, the thin slices as crystalline as snow. Thanks for the gift from the depths of the sea.
Slow: Circular area with a radius of 5.5 meters

source_cn: 升级·商行生效，所有的【蓝色/紫色物品】升级为【精品油画小作】
ref_en: Upgrade · Trading Firm effective, all [Blue/Purple Items] upgraded to [Fine Small Oil Painting]

第7次记录：同样的咒文，在葡萄藤旁低声念和在空地上直接念，结果完全不同。前者更柔和，后者更急躁。

第11次记录：为受伤的卷毛狒狒处理伤口时，先安抚，再引导生命力流动，效果比直接催生血肉更好。

第16次记录：蘑菇精喜欢亮晶晶的光点。若将绿焰拆成更细小的流萤状，它们会自己围过来，施术消耗反而降低。

第22次记录：今天尤德拉之树的回响比昨天更清晰了一点。

第31次记录：实验外溢的问题越来越明显，苹果长得太快，湖里的龟似乎也受了影响……不管了，等这一轮数据整理完再处理。

（后面夹着几页零散的补记，字迹明显变快了。）
ref_en:
7th record: The same incantation, whispered beside the grapevines versus chanted directly in the open space, the results are completely different. The former is gentler, the latter is more impatient.

11th record: When treating the wounds of the Curly-Haired Baboon, pacifying it first and then guiding the flow of life force works better than directly stimulating flesh growth.

16th record: Mushroom sprites like shiny light spots. If the green flames are broken down into finer firefly-like shapes, they will gather around on their own, and the consumption of the spell is reduced.

22nd record: The echo of the Yodra Tree was clearer today than yesterday.

31st record: The problem of experimental overflow is becoming more and more obvious. The apples are growing too fast, and the turtles in the lake seem to have been affected... Never mind, I'll deal with it after this round of data is organized.

(A few scattered supplementary notes are tucked in the back, the handwriting is noticeably faster.)

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与伯德温·威瑟尔遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对伯德温·威瑟尔的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302116">伯德温·威瑟尔的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with Baldwin Wetherell. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing Baldwin Wetherell: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302116">Records of Baldwin Wetherell</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>
